purpose: Separate historical membership, signal-time statistical qualification, normalization and estimator preprocessing without selecting stocks by future outcomes.

authorized_now: review of previously authorized two-ID engineering diagnostics
authorization_scope.notes: This file is a research design artifact. It does not change active workers or expand execution authorization.

active_engineering_policy_preserved.meaning: Incomplete original cohorts withhold statistical features. Raw per-security momenta remain diagnostics. A two-ID sample cannot establish full-universe normalization or coverage.

research_clock.training: rolling preceding ten completed outcome years
research_clock.feature_cutoff: closed exact independent exchange month-end signal session t
research_clock.target_interval: strictly after signal close through the complete next calendar month end
research_clock.shared_price_anchor: A signal-close price can be the final historical feature endpoint and the next-month target denominator; the return intervals do not overlap.

population_contract.full_membership_cohort: Every source-security ID admitted by dated historical membership at signal t, before price or future-outcome joins.
population_contract.economic_and_coverage_ledger: Preserve one source-security-ID/signal-date row for every original member, including unresolved identities, missing predictors, unrequested prices and missing or terminal outcomes.
population_contract.candidate_paper_population: One common signal-time qualified subset of the original cohort with all five raw momenta available, used for every paper momentum horizon at that signal.
population_contract.normalization_denominator: common paper-qualified member count for that signal, after predeclared past-input qualification
population_contract.subset_statistics_claim_limit: Qualified-subset means and SDs are not certified full-universe market statistics; original-cohort coverage must accompany them.

exhaustive_request_contract.requested_provider_ids: Every unique, nonquarantined provider ID reachable from the complete original signal cohort; unresolved IDs remain explicit in the original denominator.

candidate_paper_qualification.required_monthly_price_anchors: All thirteen exact exchange month ends t-12 through t, inclusive, covering every intermediate endpoint required by the five raw momenta.
candidate_paper_qualification.monthly_price_anchor: Exact independent exchange month end; no preceding available stock quote substitution.
candidate_paper_qualification.raw_momentum_requirements: Each MOM1/3/6/9/12 finite with positive compounded gross return and complete required monthly endpoint history.
candidate_paper_qualification.interior_daily_price_path_note: The monthly baseline requires complete monthly anchors; daily technical windows and future daily backtest completeness have separate dependency contracts.

paper_fifteen_candidate_normalization.evidence: PAPER equations 6-8; common-qualified cross-section and sample-SD convention are declared PROPOSED V2 choices, not undocumented author settings.

raw_momenta.MOM3: compound monthly returns t-2 through t-1, two returns
raw_momenta.MOM6: compound monthly returns t-5 through t-1, five returns
raw_momenta.MOM9: compound monthly returns t-8 through t-1, eight returns
raw_momenta.MOM12: compound monthly returns t-11 through t-1, eleven returns

paper_fifteen_candidate_normalization.mean: equal-security arithmetic mean of raw MOMm within the qualified signal cohort
paper_fifteen_candidate_normalization.shared_state_variables: Replicate each horizon's meanMOMm and stdMOMm for qualified stocks at the same signal. Retain time-varying levels.
paper_fifteen_candidate_normalization.shared_state_reason: They are identical across stocks within a month; centering would remove the state and cross-sectional SD is zero.

mathematical_validity.standard_deviation: finite and strictly positive for each of five horizons

paper_fifteen_candidate_normalization.invalid_dispersion_policy: Keep member rows and raw diagnostics; withhold affected normalized/mean/SD triplets. Do not manufacture zero features. Flag the signal's baseline usability separately.
paper_fifteen_candidate_normalization.paper_comparison_population: Qualified signal rows with all fifteen baseline inputs mathematically defined and the still-open research coverage gates satisfied; never selected by future target availability.

empirical_adequacy_gates.threshold_selection_basis: Bounded coverage evidence, normalization representativeness and intended model/trial design; no return, validation-score or backtest-performance optimization.

added_feature_missingness.dictionary_counts_evidence: VERIFIED LOCAL definitions: 298 technical + 415 context + 15 paper; ten rank aliases and three structural constants excluded from predictors.
added_feature_missingness.candidate_initial_research_policy: Leave added-feature values NaN. Choose and record an estimator's explicit handling before fitting; do not silently remove paper-qualified rows to create complete cases across the entire library.
added_feature_missingness.missingness_indicators_as_predictors: OPEN; audit whether the mask is genuinely available at signal time and whether it proxies source/provider coverage before adding it to the frozen feature dictionary.
added_feature_missingness.cross_sectional_extension_population: OPEN. Current engineering workers still require complete original signal cohorts. A common paper-qualified or predeclared feature-specific eligible population needs a separate documented decision before activation.
added_feature_missingness.interpretation: Per-column missingness is distinct from global prediction eligibility. Context values calculated over different populations require separate population labels and coverage.

target_and_accounting_missingness.training_observability: Only outcomes completed and available by the declared training cutoff; preserve missing-target reasons and original denominators.
target_and_accounting_missingness.relative_class_definition_and_missing_ta: OPEN_FOR_LABEL_PROTOCOL; normalization policy does not silently choose decile/tie rules or certify economic outcomes.
target_and_accounting_missingness.missing_terminal_event_accounting: UNRESOLVED; provider-adjusted endpoint ratios do not certify delisting, merger or cash-flow completeness.

estimator_preprocessing_and_comparison.forest_scaler_choice: PROPOSED_NONE; feature-specific transforms remain part of the declared feature definitions.
estimator_preprocessing_and_comparison.ridge_or_neural_model_preprocessing: Conditional future extension; fit any scaler, clipping threshold, imputer and missingness treatment on inner-training rows only during validation and then the outer training window for the final refit.
estimator_preprocessing_and_comparison.monthly_cross_sectional_feature_transfor: Observable same-signal cohort operation, distinct from a learned pooled training scaler. It changes feature meaning and is not justified solely as tree preprocessing.
estimator_preprocessing_and_comparison.common_model_comparison_population: Same frozen paper-qualified stock/signal prediction rows and same completed-label training rows across candidate models; preserve missing-target prediction rows in coverage and economic accounting.
estimator_preprocessing_and_comparison.shared_state_scaler_weighting: OPEN if scaling is later added: stock-row weighting and equal-month weighting differ because state values repeat across stocks; record the chosen fitting population.

bounded_coverage_audit.anchor_rationale: Initial, middle and final portions of the chosen initial 2000-2009 training history, preselected without inspecting prediction or strategy performance.
bounded_coverage_audit.stage_one: Source metadata and declared-request audit only: original membership counts, identity routes/quarantine, source date windows and provenance. No new financial-value reads.
bounded_coverage_audit.stage_two_current_scope: Summarize already authorized two-ID engineering raw-momentum and feature-availability diagnostics as sample diagnostics only; do not infer full-cohort dispersion or coverage.
bounded_coverage_audit.new_exhaustive_financial_coverage_stage: Not authorized by this file. Needs a separately measured read/execution plan before actual common-qualified population counts can be verified.
required_outputs: available raw-momentum diagnostic counts with scope
unknown full-cohort financial qualification stated explicitly
resource budget and actual metadata-read measurements
bounded_coverage_audit.anchor_clock_note: Representative signal month-ends inside2000-2009trainingyears. They are not preceding-month signals for Januaryoutcomes; the firstJanuary2000outcome uses1999-12-31.

limitations: Retrieval-time identity routes do not prove historical mapping availability or lifetime security continuity.
Provider-adjusted history lacks independently verified revision-as-of evidence.
Historical membership availability timestamps are not an independent original-publication certificate.
A qualified subset may have nonrandom source/identity/history missingness and must not be labelled complete or bias-free.
No feature transformations repair unresolved terminal-event economic accounting.
source_pit_and_bias_claim_limits.permitted_claim: Explicit past-input arithmetic and historical membership reconstruction with preserved coverage denominators; qualification and empirical representativeness still subject to audit.

activation_requirements: Select and record the primary historical universe.
Review the bounded metadata audit and distinguish sample from exhaustive requests.
Prepare an appropriate bounded plan before new exhaustive financial qualification reads.
Verify actual common-qualified five-momentum population coverage and missingness using exhaustive declared cohorts.
Resolve and freeze empirical count/coverage/training-history adequacy gates without performance-driven selection.
Choose and freeze added-feature context populations and estimator missing-value treatment.
Freeze inner-validation and estimator-specific preprocessing rules before any model fit.
Review adversarial tests for source identity quarantine, original denominator preservation, future-price invariance and independent feature/target clocks.
Version and document any deliberate departure from active complete-cohort engineering policy before activating it.

coverage_evidence.anchor_scope: Preselected representative dates inside initial2000-2009training window; January2000 is not the December1999 first-outcome signal.
coverage_evidence.existing_two_id_diagnostics: All 298 technical and five raw monthly momenta available at both signal dates for two IDs; no full-cohort price-coverage inference.
coverage_evidence.activation_conclusion: Current identity-qualified subsets are only 15.7–33.6 percent of original members at inspected dates. Keep the proposal inactive; no adequacy threshold is justified. Dated identity review and bounded exhaustive input-history qualification remain required.
